title: AAPS 4.0.0.0-dev-a problems with NSClientV3 Queue
body: I am having problems with sending TR I guess. This morning my Queue was 48 and woudn't come down. Then I retarted AAPS and after the Medtronic MMT754 pump connected, the Queue went down to 11 and after a while it went down to 0... But this repeats frequently. Sending my logs... This happened around 8 AM today. medtronic difference is that loading pump history takes time
